nodes.label: Deploy to production workflow
nodes.rationale: Push/merge to main builds images on GitHub runners and pushes to GHCR; the EC2 server never builds because it only has ~1.9 GB RAM. Concurrency group production-deploy with cancel-in-progress false so a deploy is never killed halfway.

nodes.label: deploy job (SSH to EC2, pull and restart)
nodes.norm_label: deploy job (ssh to ec2, pull and restart)

nodes.label: docker-compose.ghcr.yml (production compose)
nodes.rationale: Pulls prebuilt GHCR images instead of building on the server; uses backend/.env already on the server; IMAGE_OWNER/IMAGE_TAG set by the deploy job.

nodes.label: backend service (GHCR image)
nodes.rationale: init: true reaps orphaned Chrome zombies left by PDF generation.

nodes.label: GHCR image registry (ghcr.io)
nodes.rationale: Image prefix lowercased because GHCR requires lowercase names; images tagged latest and commit sha.

nodes.label: backend/migrate.js database migration
nodes.rationale: Creates enums, tables, indexes and constraints based on vcare_schema.sql backup; can run via shell, Dockerfile, or on server startup.

nodes.label: render.yaml Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure as code, reproducible deployments, automatic database creation.

nodes.label: Database schema overview (users, bookings, quotations, transactions...)

nodes.label: Backend health wait loop (/health, 150s)
nodes.rationale: Backend runs DB migrations on boot, so deploy polls /health up to 30x5s and dumps backend logs on failure.
